title: Count Almost Equal Pairs I
summary: Given an array nums consisting of positive integers, count the number of index pairs (i, j) where i < j such that nums[i] and nums[j] can become equal after performing at most one operation of swapping any two digits within one of the numbers.
statement: Given an array nums consisting of positive integers, count the number of index pairs (i, j) where i < j such that nums[i] and nums[j] can become equal after performing at most one operation of swapping any two digits within one of the numbers.
constraints: 2≤len(nums)≤100 and values are positive integers up to 1,000,000.
A pair is almost equal if swapping at most two digit positions in either one number makes their integer values equal.
Leading zeros after a swap are allowed; count index pairs i<j.
hints: Each number has only O(d²) values reachable by zero or one digit swap.
Generate that small set for every number, then test whether either endpoint reaches the other.
Parse swapped strings as integers so a leading zero naturally disappears; count each i<j once.
The allowed operation changes exactly one endpoint, so membership in either reachability set is necessary and sufficient.
